# AvatarGroup

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

media and display · tier 2 · beta · renders on the server and ships no client JavaScript.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For the people on one thing: reviewers, assignees, a team. Render every member and let
the group hide the overflow.

```tsx
<AvatarGroup max={2} aria-label="Reviewers">
  <AvatarRoot role="img" aria-label="Omar Abed"><AvatarFallback>OA</AvatarFallback></AvatarRoot>
  <AvatarRoot role="img" aria-label="Lina Haddad"><AvatarFallback>LH</AvatarFallback></AvatarRoot>
  <AvatarRoot role="img" aria-label="Sara Khalil"><AvatarFallback>SK</AvatarFallback></AvatarRoot>
</AvatarGroup>
```

`max` counts children: the first `max` show, and a last circle says `+N` and is read out as
`labels.avatar.more` ("1 more"). `size` reaches that circle only, so give each avatar the
same `size`. For Arabic, pass `labels` and `locale` from `getLabels('ar')`.

**Naming it.** Give the group an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`: it says who the faces
are, and without it "1 more" has nothing to count. Name each avatar too, by the `alt` of its
picture or by `role="img"` and `aria-label` on `AvatarRoot`, because initials alone are silent.

With `size="custom"`, size every child and the counter from the group: `className="*:size-16"`.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { AvatarGroup } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | - | Every member, one avatar per child; the group shows the first `max` and counts the rest. |
| `labels` | no | `Labels` | - | The built-in strings; the counter is named by `labels.avatar.more`. Defaults to English. |
| `locale` | no | `string` | - | The BCP 47 tag the count is formatted in. Defaults to `en`. |
| `max` | no | `integer`, min 1, max 20 | `4` | How many children show before the +N counter takes the rest; clamped to 1-20. |
| `size` | no | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` \| `custom` | `"md"` | The size of the +N counter; pass the size the avatars carry. custom emits none. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
